Injured Bengal Slow Loris Rescued in Assam

An injured Bengal Slow Loris was discovered on a roadside in Karbi Anglong, Assam. The rare animal was subsequently rescued. Following its rescue, the slow loris was returned to the forest. This incident highlights the presence of this species in the region and the efforts made for its conservation.
